description.zh:
返回值语言，取值：

- zh：中文。

- en：英文。

默认值：en
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese.

- en: English.

Default value: en.
The region ID of the outbound VPC.

description.zh:
VPC类型。取值：

- STANDARD：标准VPC。

- EDS：无影工作区VPC。
description.en:
The VPC type. Valid values:

- STANDARD: standard VPC.

- EDS: Elastic Desktop Service workspace VPC.

descriptions.zh: ><notice>本接口采用全量覆盖机制，调用时会清除所有未包含在本次请求中的原有 VPC 绑定关系。如需新增 VPC，请务必将存量 VPC ID 一并传入。></notice>
descriptions.en:
><notice>

This operation performs a full replacement. Any existing VPC associations not included in your request will be removed. To add a new VPC, you must include the IDs of all VPCs that should remain associated.

></notice>

example.unifiedCli: aliyun pvtz bind-resolver-rule-vpc --lang en --rule-id hr0000 --vpc VpcType=STANDARD VpcId=vpc-f8zvrvr1payllgz380000 RegionId=cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun pvtz BindResolverRuleVpc --region cn-hangzhou --Vpc.1.VpcType STANDARD --Vpc.1.VpcId 'vpc-f8zvrvr1payllgz380000' --RuleId hr0000 --Lang en --Vpc.1.RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
